question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 10, 20 and 30 days, respectively. In how many days can A do the work if he is assisted by B and C on every third day?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do work in 10 days

B can do work in 20 days

C can do work in 30 days

Formula used:

Work done = Time taken × Efficiency

Time taken ∝ (1)/(Efficiency)

Calculation:

The efficiency of A is (1)/(10)

The efficiency of B is (1)/(20)

The efficiency of C is (1)/(30)
